items.period: Shang (style label on the modern redraw)
items.caption: Modern vector redraw of 白 in Shang oracle-script style; the Commons page traces it to Hanziyuan image j18614. It can serve as a candidate comparison for the early graphic form, not as a photograph of an excavated inscription.
items.alt: Black vector character form centered on a plain background, labeled as 白 in Shang oracle-script style.
items.selection_reason: A character-specific early-form candidate with a stated upstream image identifier and reusable public-domain designation.
items.rights: Commons declares the SVG representation public domain; attribution is appreciated but not required.

items.period: Bronze-script style; the Commons page does not assign this particular candidate a narrower dated period
items.caption: Modern vector redraw of 白 in bronze-script style, sourced by the Commons page to Hanziyuan image b12080. It is a script-style comparison, not a photograph of an inscribed bronze vessel.
items.alt: Black vector character form centered on a plain background, labeled as 白 in bronze-script style.
items.selection_reason: Pairs with the oracle-style candidate to compare two early script-style forms; the page supplies a character-specific upstream identifier and a public-domain declaration.
items.rights: Commons declares the SVG representation public domain and notes a Richard Sears permission reference in its permission field.

items.period: Shuowen seal-script style (Han-era dictionary tradition; the file page does not date an artifact)
items.caption: Modern vector redraw of the form labeled Shuowen seal-script style, sourced by the Commons page to Hanziyuan image s02539. It represents a later dictionary tradition, not a surviving Han artifact photograph.
items.alt: Black vector character form centered on a plain background, labeled as 白 in Shuowen seal-script style.
items.selection_reason: Shows a later transmitted form for comparison with the earlier-script candidates and has a character-specific source identifier and public-domain declaration.
items.rights: Commons declares the SVG representation public domain and notes a Richard Sears permission reference in its permission field.

limitations.text: All three are modern digital redrawings. Commons descriptions do not establish that the individual vector forms reproduce a particular excavated inscription or artifact.
The web tool exposed the exact original-file URLs but did not render the SVG content; visual identity remains for downstream inspection.
